name: Estella
detailed_description:
About the Game

In the vast universe of the rhythm music game Estella, you take on the role of a comet flying through the stars and traveling through planets on a musical adventure. You will hear, play, and experience the stories of distinct characters on each planet—revealing a story in which fate and music are intertwined.

🎵 The Ideal Combination of Mechanics and Music

An inventive octagonal hitbox interface is a feature of the game. To hit rhythm notes precisely, players need to be adept at using both the mouse and the keyboard.

You'll encounter a variety of gameplay actions, including tapping, holding, and dodging, with notes of different colors and shapes.

A completely immersive visual and rhythmic experience is provided by the Sky Notes that appear above, adding an additional layer of difficulty.

🪐 Planet System: Story Progression Based on Chapters

With a number of distinctively styled songs and narrative components, each chapter symbolizes a planet.

In order to delve into the stories of the characters on each planet, players will progressively unlock narrative segments and musical tracks.

Once you reach significant milestones, you will need to pass certain phases in order to continue.

Non-main-story content, such as separately updated levels and additional tracks, is available on the Chaos Planet.
